items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Jack had his own band and Buddy had his own band. I know, but they played against him.

ctx.x: What's the name of the band that used to play at the ghost club next to Buddy Pee, you know they used to play a game two times? At the ghost club, they used to have a big thing in there.
